Fed meeting recap: Powell to stay on board

summary: FOMC voted 8-4 on April 29, 2026 to hold rates at 3.5%-3.75%. Third consecutive hold. Inflation elevated partly due to global energy prices. Markets pricing no changes rest of 2026 and into 2027. Powell's chairmanship ending; leadership transition underway.
